title: Progress Report Improvements
comment:
1. Day's loss due to weather is displayed in two spots. Remove it from the main dashboard and keep it in the details section. 
2. Verify that the project team is pulling from the project directory. This section should have the ability to update the assigned project team members. 
3. Separate the past week's highlights, upcoming week activities, and open items in separate sections. 
4. Improve the design of the highlights for each section so it's not just a bullet point.
